name: @structured-world/structured-zstd
description: Pure-Rust Zstandard (zstd) codec compiled to WebAssembly — compress and decompress in the browser, Node.js and Deno, with automatic SIMD (simd128) acceleration and a scalar fallback. No native addons, no FFI.
author: Structured World Foundation <foundation@sw.foundation>

scripts.build:wasm:simd: cd .. && wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir npm/simd --out-name structured_zstd_wasm -- --config 'target.wasm32-unknown-unknown.rustflags=["-C","target-feature=+simd128"]'
scripts.build:wasm:scalar: cd .. && wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir npm/scalar --out-name structured_zstd_wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm:simd && npm run build:wasm:scalar && npm run build:ts
